title: (A ∪ B)ᶜ in {1, …, 10}
caption: A = evens and B = multiples of 3. The union covers 2, 3, 4, 6, 8, 9, 10, so its complement is {1, 5, 7}: the elements outside both circles, which is also Aᶜ ∩ Bᶜ.
alt: A Venn diagram with evens in A, multiples of 3 in B, 6 in the overlap and 1, 5 and 7 outside both circles.
description: Place 1 to 10: evens in A, multiples of 3 in B, and 6 in both.
A ∪ B holds everything inside either circle.
The complement (A ∪ B)ᶜ is what lies outside both circles: {1, 5, 7}.
That is the same as Aᶜ ∩ Bᶜ, as De Morgan says.

checks.name: Aᶜ ∩ Bᶜ has the same 3 elements
